sources.title: Ling 3.0 Flash API - Demo - DeepInfra
sources.snippet: We're introducing Ling-3.0-flash, our next-generation native hybrid reasoning model. Operating with 124B total and 5.1B active parameters (~12.4% and ~8.1% of our previous 1T-class flagship Ring-2.6-1T), Ling-3.0-flash matches or outperforms its predecessor across key benchmarks.

sources.title: Ling
sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-flash Ling-3.0-flash is the latest-generation cost-effective model in the Ling series, with 124B total parameters, 5.1B activated parameters, a native 256K context window extendable up to 1M.

sources.title: InclusionAI Ling 3.0 Flash Complete Guide: 124B MoE with Hybrid Reasoning
sources.snippet: Ling 3.0 Flash is a 124B MoE model with 5.1B active parameters. Hybrid reasoning mode, 262K context, free on OpenRouter. Specs and setup.
